title: The coefficient, tensor, and strict fiber interfaces for the Frobenius unit square
statement: Retain the completed quotient-ring presentation, its conjugated coefficient isomorphism, the actual signed total tensor and its canonical pullback comparison alpha, normalized constant generators, positive-power Koszul tower, product, signed fiber, and actual unit (u,0). NormalizedFiber records the beta product projections and both mapping-fiber coordinates; DerivedSquare and StrictSquare are precisely the previously published predicates of lem-wf-tensor-pullback-completion-unit-square. These are definitions, with no chosen unproved data.
